benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench 4.0
benchmarks.description: Terminal agent task resolution; exact 4.0.0 release, not 2.x or 3.x. Scores describe model-plus-agent systems.

benchmarks.name: DeepSWE v1.1
benchmarks.description: 113 long-horizon engineering tasks; committed patches graded in a clean isolated verifier. Raw artifact pass_at_1 is a fraction, not the rounded website percentage.

benchmarks.name: SWE-Bench Pro V2 Public
benchmarks.description: Validated public split: 642 tasks across 11 repositories; locked agent network and pristine-image patch regrading. Excludes legacy 731-task v1, HARD-51 and private results.

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1
benchmarks.description: 70 expert-curated scientific research workflows in release v0.1.0. Official aggregate resolution rates cover three trials per task; model-plus-agent systems, not bare models.
